# Bench wiring: one manifold, five pots — 2026-09-02

Wiring drawings and pin map to bench ONE manifold (5 outlets) with 5 soil-moisture sensors, the Sensor Kit temperature and light modules, an analog mux and an I2C expander (so more manifolds bolt on without rewiring), the pump with its driver and interlock, the inline flow meter, the float hall, the manifold's servo and its two halls. No PCB, no enclosure; KiCad comes once the bench has fixed the part choices. Source of truth: [`nets.py`](nets.py) (every wire, every table); the drawings and this file are generated from it.

## Binding rules

From the umbrella [DECISIONS.md](../../DECISIONS.md) #5 and #7 and the pitches "Bench rig" and "Don't flood the flat":

- Actuators (pump, servo) on their own supply with a common ground; neither ever draws from the board's 5 V pin (DECISIONS #7).
- The pump is OFF unless the MCU actively asserts PUMP_EN: an MCU in reset, a floating pin, a boot, an unpowered logic chip, the I2C expander's power-on state, an unplugged or dead float sensor and a lifted tank all mean pump off.
- The float is both in the driver circuit (74HC00 gate) and on a sense pin (D5).
- Failure direction is dry: NAS or WiFi down, unknown manifold position, float says empty -> no watering (DECISIONS #5). The backend decides when to water; the firmware only enforces caps.
- Firmware side of the bench: hall pulse counting on the lead screw plus a home hall (polled), flow sanity from the meter, sensors reported raw as (controller, channel) counts.
- 12 V loop on a soldered perfboard with screw terminals and >= 0.5 mm2 wire; breadboard and Dupont only for 5 V logic.

![overview](overview.png)

*overview.png* — every used UNO pin labelled; orange (5V_BOARD) and brown (5V_SERVO) never meet and the UBEC output ends at the servo; the pump's purple return goes to the perfboard, not to a GND pin; the hydraulic strip along the bottom has the reservoir above the pump inlet.

## Pin map

Pins are inputs with pull-ups off at reset; D0/D1 stay free for serial; D6 is set LOW before it becomes an OUTPUT. `Wire` (A4/A5) is 5 V with no on-board pull-ups; the Qwiic connector is `Wire1` at 3.3 V and is not used.

- EN tied to GND (always enabled): some breakouts pull EN down with 10 k, which the expander cannot lift.

## Pump driver and interlock (perfboard)

G1 inverts the float hall (LOW = magnet = water OK) into FLOAT_OK, which goes to D5 and to G2; G2 = NAND(PUMP_EN, FLOAT_OK); G3 inverts that into the MOSFET gate through R1. Every pull resistor pulls toward "off": R3 holds PUMP_EN low, R2 holds the gate low, R4 lifts an open float line to "block".

![pump-driver](pump-driver.png)

*pump-driver.png* — follow the 12 V loop F1 -> PUMP+ -> pump -> PUMP- -> Q1 drain -> source -> star; the only path to the gate is G3 through R1; R2 and R3 pull to GND, R4 pulls FLT_S up; FLOAT_OK leaves G1 for both G2 and D5.

| terminal | wire | net | gauge |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 12V_IN | brick 12V+ via F1 (T 3 A slow-blow) | 12V | >= 0.5 mm2 |
| PUMP+ | pump +; D1 stripe (cathode) here | 12V | >= 0.5 mm2 |
| PUMP- | pump -; Q1 drain | PUMP_SW | >= 0.5 mm2 |
| GND (star) | brick 12V-, UBEC IN-/OUT-, servo brown, UNO GND, breadboard GND rail | GND | >= 0.5 mm2 for the 12 V returns |
| 5V_BOARD | UNO 5 V pin (U1 VCC, R4) | 5V_BOARD | Dupont |
| PUMP_EN | UNO D6 (R3 10 k pull-down) | SIGNAL | Dupont |
| FLOAT_OK | UNO D5 (G1 out) | SIGNAL | Dupont |
| FLT_S | float hall S (R4 100 k pull-up) | SIGNAL | 3-pin plug |

### Parts on the perfboard

| ref | value | role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| F1 | T 3 A slow-blow, 5x20 | pump branch, + leg only; value fixed after bring-up 7f |
| F2 | 1 A, 5x20 | UNO VIN + UBEC input, + leg only |
| D1 | SS34 / 1N5819 | flyback across the pump, stripe (cathode) to PUMP+ |
| Q1 | logic-level N-MOSFET module (AO3400 / IRLZ44N / D4184) | low side: drain PUMP-, source star GND, gate via R1; NOT an IRF520 |
| R1 | 100 ohm | G3 out -> gate series |
| R2 | 10 k | gate pull-down to GND (even if the module has one) |
| R3 | 10 k | PUMP_EN pull-down: LOW at reset / boot / floating |
| R4 | 100 k | FLT_S pull-up to 5V_BOARD: unplugged = HIGH = block |
| U1 | 74HC00 quad NAND, DIP-14 | VCC 5V_BOARD (pin 14), GND star (pin 7) |
| C1 | 100 nF | across U1 VCC / GND |

### 74HC00 gates (U1, DIP-14: VCC pin 14, GND pin 7)

| gate | inputs | output | DIP pins | role |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| G1 | FLT_S, FLT_S | FLOAT_OK | A 1, B 2, Y 3 | inverter: hall LOW (magnet) -> FLOAT_OK HIGH; also to D5 |
| G2 | PUMP_EN, FLOAT_OK | G2_OUT | A 4, B 5, Y 6 | NAND: LOW only when both are HIGH |
| G3 | G2_OUT, G2_OUT | GATE | A 9, B 10, Y 8 | inverter -> R1 100 ohm -> MOSFET gate |
| G4 | GND, GND | n/c | A 12, B 13, Y 11 | unused: inputs tied to GND |

### Truth table

Only the first row runs the pump.

| case | PUMP_EN (D6) | magnet | float module | 5V_BOARD | FLT_S | FLOAT_OK (D5) | gate | pump |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| watering | HIGH | at hall | plugged, powered | on | LOW | HIGH | HIGH | RUNS |
| firmware idle | LOW | at hall | plugged, powered | on | LOW | HIGH | LOW | off |
| tank low (level past the margin) | HIGH | away | plugged, powered | on | HIGH | LOW | LOW | off |
| tank lifted off the hall | HIGH | away | plugged, powered | on | HIGH | LOW | LOW | off |
| float hall unplugged | HIGH | any | S open | on | HIGH (R4) | LOW | LOW | off |
| float hall GND lead off | HIGH | any | no return | on | HIGH (R4) | LOW | LOW | off |
| float hall VCC lost / dead hall | HIGH | any | unpowered | on | HIGH (R4) | LOW | LOW | off |
| MCU in reset / boot / D6 not yet OUTPUT / jumper pulled | floating -> LOW (R3) | any | any | on | - | - | LOW | off |
| board 5 V absent (USB out, board dead) | - | any | any | off | - | LOW | LOW (R2) | off |
| 12 V absent | any | any | any | any | - | - | - | off (unpowered) |

- Failure direction is dry: every open, unplug, power loss and reset lands on 'off'.
- Residual (not in the brief): a float hall output shorted to GND, or the magnet stuck to the hall, reads as a permanent 'allow' that D5 cannot tell apart; the firmware dose cap and the flow-meter no-flow timeout bound it.

### Read the label first

These decide a wire, a fuse or a library call, so they come before anything is plugged in:

- **Whadda WPSE313 hall module** — VERIFY on-board pull-up (ours is fitted regardless); LED lights at the magnet's south pole
- **Sensor Kit temperature/humidity** — READ THE MODULE: DHT11 (D7, Environment.setPin(7)) or DHT20 (I2C 0x38, Environment_I2C)
- **pump, 12 V DC diaphragm** — READ THE LABEL: voltage, running current (assume <= 1.5 A), inrush 3-5x; measure in 7f, then fix F1
- **12 V brick** — READ THE LABEL: amps (a 2 A brick browns out at pump start)
- **MOSFET module, logic level, low side** — READ THE LABEL: AO3400 / IRLZ44N / D4184 ok, IRF520 NOT; meter: own gate pull-down? If a relay module came: H/L jumper to H or an NPN inverter (out -> 4.7 k -> base, emitter GND, collector -> IN)
- **flow meter YF-S401** — READ THE SUFFIX: -0207 (0.2-3 L/min) or -3507 (0.3-6 L/min); ~5880 pulses/L; vertical, flow up; 5V_BOARD only

## Hydraulic chain

The reservoir sits ABOVE the pump inlet so any pump type is gravity-primed; the flow meter is vertical with the flow upward. Tubing is the teal strip on the overview drawing.

| stage | detail |
| --- | --- |
| reservoir | ABOVE the pump inlet (gravity-primed); float hall at the top stop, float keyed |
| pump | 12 V diaphragm, inlet below the reservoir surface |
| silicone tube 30-50 cm | soft: pulsation damper |
| flow meter | vertical, flow UPWARD, tilt <= 5 deg; no pulses below its flow floor |
| manifold inlet | one manifold, 5 outlets |
| outlets 1-5 | pots, or the bucket on the bench |

## Power

Two 5 V rails, named and coloured apart: **5V_BOARD** (orange) is the UNO's 5 V pin, an output, feeding sensors and logic; **5V_SERVO** (brown) is the UBEC output and has exactly one destination, the servo's red lead. One GND star on the perfboard; the pump return reaches it through the MOSFET, never through the board's GND pin. Fuses sit in the + leg only, never in a return.

![power](power.png)

*power.png* — the two 5 V rails visibly apart; F1 and F2 in the + legs only; the pump return through the MOSFET to the star, never through the board's GND pin; a current next to every consumer.

### Budget

| rail | consumer | current | note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 12V | pump (via F1) | <= 1.5 A running, 3-5x inrush | ASSUME: read the label, measure in 7f |
| 12V | UNO VIN (via F2) | ~0.15 A | board + the 5V_BOARD load through the on-board buck |
| 12V | UBEC input (via F2) | ~0.35 A at servo stall | F2 1 A covers VIN + UBEC |
| 5V_BOARD | 5x moisture | ~25 mA |  |
| 5V_BOARD | 3x hall (LEDs) | ~30 mA | screw, home, float |
| 5V_BOARD | flow meter | ~15 mA | never from 12 V |
| 5V_BOARD | MUX, PCF8575, 74HC00, DHT11, LDR, pull-ups | < 10 mA |  |
| 5V_BOARD | total | ~120 mA | the rows sum to ~80 mA; 120 mA is the budget with margin, of <= ~1 A on VIN |
| 5V_SERVO | SG90 continuous | ~250 mA run, ~650 mA stall | UBEC >= 3 A; its only load |

### Fuses

| ref | value | branch | leg |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F1 | T 3 A slow-blow | pump (perfboard 12V_IN) | + only |
| F2 | 1 A | UNO VIN (barrel) and UBEC input | + only |

Bench alternative: USB-C powers the UNO; the 12 V brick powers the pump branch and the UBEC; grounds common at the star.

### Never

- UBEC output to the UNO 5 V pin: never (5V_SERVO and 5V_BOARD stay apart; continuity check 0).
- 12 V to any 5 V rail or to the flow meter: never.
- Feed the UNO 5 V pin from outside: never (it is an output).
- Servo or pump on the board's 5 V pin: never.
- A fuse in a return leg: never (+ leg only).
- The pump return through the board GND pin: never (MOSFET source -> star).
- PUMP_EN or the servo on the I2C expander: never (power-on HIGH).
- Breadboard or Dupont in the 12 V loop: never (soldered perfboard, screw terminals, >= 0.5 mm2).

## Bench command set

The bench firmware is a separate deliverable under the plan pitches "Pump on command" and "Bench rig"; it is not in this directory. This wiring assumes it provides these serial commands, which the bring-up below uses:

| command | does |
| --- | --- |
| `i2c` | scan Wire, list addresses (expect 0x20; 0x38 if DHT20) |
| `mux <0-15>\|all` | select, wait >= 1 ms, read twice, print the second (14-bit raw) |
| `hall` | stream screw / home / float (D5 FLOAT_OK) pin states |
| `flow` | pulses per second on D2 and total since reset |
| `servo <+-us> <ms>` | bounded: pulse offset for <= cap ms, then stop |
| `home` | run toward home until HALL_HOME, bounded time, zero the count |
| `goto <1-5>` | step to the outlet counting screw pulses, bounded |
| `pump <ms>` | PUMP_EN HIGH for <= cap ms; refused while FLOAT_OK (D5) is LOW |
| `status` | pins, counts, last error, uptime |

## Bring-up order

In this order, each step proving one thing; the fail-dry proofs are 7a-7e. `pump` is refused while FLOAT_OK is LOW, so step 4 needs the magnet at the float hall.

| step | do | proves |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Continuity before power: UBEC+ to UNO 5 V OPEN; 12 V to every 5 V rail OPEN; all GNDs common at the star. | the two 5 V rails are apart |
| 1 | Board alone on USB: `i2c` sees 0x20 (and 0x38 if DHT20). | I2C, pull-ups |
| 2 | Mux + one moisture sensor: `mux all` reads all 16 channels, the wired one moves when wetted. | select lines, ADC path |
| 3 | Halls: LED and pin follow a magnet; then the cart end-to-end three times with the same pulse count. | pulse counting, home |
| 4 | Flow meter: prime with `pump` into the bucket until no bubbles; pump a weighed 500 ml through outlet 1 counting pulses = the ml/pulse calibration; record the lowest flow that still pulses and set the no-pulse timeout from it. | meter variant, calibration, floor |
| 5 | Float: magnet away = D5 LOW = blocked; magnet at hall = D5 HIGH = allowed; meter the S line with the magnet away (>= 4 V). | sense path and pull-up |
| 6 | Servo on 5V_SERVO only: `servo`, `home`, `goto`. | servo power apart from the board |
| 7a | Pump, bucket only: float blocked -> `pump 2000` must NOT run. | interlock blocks |
| 7b | Float allowed -> `pump 2000` runs. | interlock allows |
| 7c | RESET pressed mid-dose -> stops. | R3 pull-down |
| 7d | Float hall unplugged mid-dose -> stops. | R4 pull-up |
| 7e | D6 jumper pulled mid-dose -> stops. | no hidden path to the gate |
| 7f | Measure pump start and dead-head current; fix the F1 value. | fuse value |

make -C cad/wiring            # drawings (SVG + PNG at 150 dpi) and this README
